summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Fusion Fuel Green PLC, an Irish foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release that announces selected Q1 2026 financial results for its subsidiary Quality Industrial Corp. (QIND) and provides a business update. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special category. It includes extensive forward-looking statements and risk disclosures but no deal terms or corporate action. The press release is furnished under Item 2.02 of Form 8-K equivalent, with no binding transaction.
